serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: GetWell Anywhere Federal (GWA-F) is a comprehensive digital patient engagement platform designed to guide, educate, entertain, navigate, and survey patients throughout their entire care journey. From pre-procedure preparation to the ED waiting room, inpatient settings, and post-discharge recovery, GWA-F ensures continuous support. Integrated with EMR systems, it provides automated, personalized, and proactive guidance for each patient, achieving scalable, individualized care through web and mobile applications. Additionally, GWA-F automates repetitive tasks for clinicians—such as patient education, EMR documentation, and non-clinical requests—allowing them to focus on providing top-of-license care.
